feat(orders): validate changes before persistence

Validate table and takeout order targets before creating orders. Reject unavailable menu items and prevent item updates once an order is no longer open.

feat(orders): reserve menu item stock atomically

Track optional per-item availability quantities and reserve aggregated stock in the same transaction that persists order items. Restore previous quantities safely during replacements and reject concurrent or insufficient-stock changes without partial writes.

feat(orders): enforce server-side item pricing

Reject price and unitPrice fields in order item requests. Persist unit prices exclusively from the server catalog and cover both manipulated and valid payloads with validation tests.

feat(orders): dispatch orders to kitchen KDS

Create one sequenced KDS ticket while atomically transitioning an open order to SENT_TO_KITCHEN. Broadcast order:created through the kitchen WebSocket namespace only after persistence succeeds.
